metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since they loved Inside Out 2, they will definitely enjoy the original emotional and clever adventure that started it all.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: After watching Frozen II, kids will love experiencing the musical magic, sisterly bond, and original songs of the first film.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A beloved Pixar classic that delivers lots of laughs, a heartwarming friendship, and imaginative family-friendly fun.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: An incredibly fun prequel showing how Mike and Sulley became best friends, packed with humor suitable for kids.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: A wonderful follow-up to Finding Nemo, full of underwater adventure, new funny sea creatures, and a heartwarming search for family.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: An action-packed, humorous Pixar film about a family of superheroes trying to blend into normal life.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: More superhero family fun and spectacular animation, especially focusing on baby Jack-Jack's hilarious new powers.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: An imaginative and funny adventure about an elderly man and a young Wilderness Explorer floating away in a house carried by balloons.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An exciting adventure movie about a young Viking befriending a legendary dragon, featuring wonderful themes of friendship and courage.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: An amazing sequel that expands the world of dragons with spectacular action sequences and emotional depth.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Having watched the first Despicable Me, kids will love returning to Gru and his funny, chaotic yellow Minions for more laughs.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: A hilarious continuation of Gru's adventures featuring a secret twin brother and plenty of classic Minion antics.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A super funny prequel dedicated entirely to the wacky, gibberish-speaking Minions that children adore.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A highly entertaining, laugh-out-loud superhero comedy that turns the typical hero-villain dynamic upside down.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A fast-paced and very funny look into what our animal companions do when we leave the house for the day.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets 2
metas.description: Offers even more charming animal antics and colorful, family-friendly humor that will keep kids thoroughly entertained.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An incredibly heartwarming Disney adventure featuring Baymax, the lovable, inflatable robot, and a team of kid heroes.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A colorful, gaming-themed adventure about a video game villain who wants to be a hero, perfect for fans of Sonic and Mario.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: A creative and funny sequel that takes the arcade characters into the vast, colorful world of the internet.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful and sun-soaked Pixar fantasy about friendship, Vespa scooters, and sea monsters disguised as humans on the Italian Riviera.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A fantastic, emotional fantasy-adventure about two elf brothers going on a magical quest in a modern mythical world.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: An inventive Pixar classic full of colorful insect characters, great humor, and an inspiring underdog story.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A high-energy, fun-filled animated film about a hotshot race car who learns the value of community and friendship.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Completes the trilogy they started, offering spectacular kung fu action, beautiful animation, and tons of humor with Po.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: They loved Simba's Pride and Mufasa, making the original Disney masterpiece an absolute must-watch for its music and story.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A magical, musical classic featuring wonderful characters, catchy songs, and an enchanting fairy tale world.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A fast-paced Disney adventure filled with magic, iconic songs, and the hilarious, high-energy antics of the Genie.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: An underwater musical fantasy with unforgettable characters and catch tunes that kids will want to sing along to.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the sequel, they will love seeing Puss in Boots' original origin story filled with humor and swashbuckling fun.

metas.name: Shrek Forever After
metas.description: A fantastic return to form for the Shrek universe, offering plenty of fairy-tale parody humor and heart.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A visually spectacular prehistoric road-trip adventure about a quirky caveman family seeking a new home.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: An incredibly colorful and high-energy sequel packed with slapstick comedy and fantastic wild creatures.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly imaginative and funny comedy about an inventor whose machine makes food fall from the sky like rain.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly creative comedy-adventure with an amazing message about imagination that kids and parents will both love.

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
metas.description: An outrageously funny, kid-friendly superhero comedy filled with colorful action and non-stop jokes.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A heartwarming, magical journey across beautiful landscapes as a group of kids helps a lovable young Yeti get back home.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A beautifully written and imaginative animated tale about overcoming fears, featuring a friendly embodiment of the Dark.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A hilarious and sweet musical comedy about a class pet lizard who starts talking to the elementary school students.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: A fantastic, modern sequel to the original Chicken Run that delivers the same charm, humor, and fun-filled escape antics.
